subject: Order #48213 arrived damaged
body:
Hi team,

My order #48213 (two ceramic pour-over sets) arrived this morning, but one of the boxes was crushed and both carafes are cracked. I've attached photos of the packaging and the damage.

Could you send replacements, or let me know how to arrange a refund? Happy to return the broken pieces if needed.

Thanks,
Dana Whitfield

subject: Re: Order #48213 arrived damaged
body:
Hi Dana,

Sorry to hear the carafes didn't survive the trip. I've opened a replacement order for both sets at no charge; it should ship within 24 hours and you'll get tracking by email.

No need to return the damaged items. I've also flagged the packing issue with our warehouse team.

Best,
Priya
Harborline Support

subject: Re: Order #48213 arrived damaged
body: That was fast, thank you Priya! I'll watch for the tracking number. Really appreciate the help.

subject: Charged twice for March subscription
body:
Hello,

I see two charges of $29.00 on my card for March 3, both labelled HARBORLINE SUB. My account is marcus.lee@example.org and I only have one subscription.

Could you refund the duplicate charge? The transaction IDs are 8FJ2-0091 and 8FJ2-0107.

Regards,
Marcus Lee

subject: Re: Charged twice for March subscription
body:
Hi Marcus,

You're right, the second charge was a retry that went through after a gateway timeout. I've refunded $29.00 to the original card; it usually posts in 3-5 business days.

Sorry for the hassle, and thanks for the transaction IDs.

Kind regards,
Tom Alvarez
Billing

subject: Can't reset my password
body:
Hi,

I've requested a password reset three times but the email never arrives. I've checked spam and the address on file is correct (this one).

My username is jonguyen. Can you help?

Thanks,
Jo Nguyen

subject: Re: Can't reset my password
body:
Hi Jo,

The reset emails were being blocked by your provider's filter. I've triggered a fresh link manually, which should arrive within a few minutes from no-reply@harborline.example.

If it still doesn't show up, reply here and we'll verify your account another way.

Best,
Priya

subject: Feature request: CSV export for order history
body:
Hi Harborline,

Is there a way to export my order history as CSV? I run a small cafe and reconcile purchases monthly, and copying from the web page is slow. Even a simple date-range export would save me hours.

Thanks for considering it.

Sam Okafor
Corner Roast

subject: Question about invoice INV-2291
body:
Hello billing,

Invoice INV-2291 lists a $12.00 'oversize shipping' line that I don't recognise. The order was four mugs, all standard size.

Could you check what that line refers to? If it's an error I'd like a corrected invoice for our accounts payable records.

Thank you,
Elena Rossi

subject: Re: Question about invoice INV-2291
body:
Hi Elena,

That line was misapplied from the previous order, which did include an oversize item. I've voided INV-2291 and issued INV-2291-R with the $12.00 removed. You'll find it attached to this thread.

Apologies for the confusion.

Tom

subject: Where is order #49002?
body:
Hi,

Order #49002 was supposed to arrive last Thursday and tracking hasn't updated since it left the depot. Is it lost, or just delayed?

Thanks,
Ben Carter

subject: Re: Where is order #49002?
body:
Hi Ben,

The carrier reports a backlog at the regional hub after the storm, and your parcel is now scheduled for tomorrow. Tracking should update tonight.

If it hasn't moved by Thursday, let us know and we'll ship a replacement.

Best,
Priya

subject: Cancel my subscription at the end of the billing period
body:
Hello,

Please cancel the Harborline Plus plan on my account (nadia.haddad@example.com) at the end of the current period so I keep access until April 30. I don't want an automatic renewal on May 1.

Could you confirm when it's done?

Thanks,
Nadia Haddad

subject: Re: Cancel my subscription at the end of the billing period
body:
Hi Nadia,

Done: your subscription is set to cancel on April 30 and will not renew. You'll keep full access until then, and we'll send a confirmation on the last day.

If you change your mind, you can reactivate any time before May 1.

Kind regards,
Tom

subject: Typo in the API quickstart docs
body:
Hi,

Small thing: in the API quickstart, the curl example uses /v2/orders/{id} but the endpoint is /v2/order/{id}. Took me twenty minutes to figure out why I kept getting 404s.

Otherwise the docs are great.

Owen

subject: Request to delete my account data
body:
Hello,

I'd like my account closed and all personal data associated with lucia.fernandes@example.net deleted, in line with the data protection rules in my region.

Please confirm what you delete and what you're required to retain for tax purposes.

Regards,
Lucia Fernandes

subject: Re: Request to delete my account data
body:
Hi Lucia,

We've received your deletion request and will process it within 30 days. Account details and marketing preferences will be erased; invoices are retained for seven years as required by tax law, with access restricted.

We'll confirm by email once complete.

Kind regards,
Harborline Privacy Team

subject: Application for warehouse coordinator role
body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the warehouse coordinator position advertised on your careers page. I've attached my CV and a short cover letter.

I have four years of experience in inventory management and hold a forklift certification. I'd welcome the chance to discuss the role.

Best regards,
Grace Lin

subject: Gift card balance not showing
body:
Hi,

I redeemed a $50 gift card yesterday and got a confirmation, but my account balance still shows $0.00. The code was HL-4K7Q-9WPM.

Can you check what happened?

Thanks,
Rafael

subject: Re: Gift card balance not showing
body:
Hi Rafael,

The card was applied to a guest checkout rather than your account, which is why the balance isn't visible. I've moved the $50 credit to your account; it should appear after you refresh the page.

Let me know if it's still missing.

Priya

subject: Do you ship to Canada?
body:
Hello,

I'm interested in the walnut desk organizer but the checkout page only offers US addresses. Do you ship to Canada, and if so what are the duties and delivery times like?

Thanks,
Ines Moreau

subject: Re: Do you ship to Canada?
body:
Hi Ines,

We do ship to Canada. At checkout, choose 'International' under shipping method and enter your province; rates are calculated by weight. Most orders arrive in 6-9 business days. Duties are collected by the carrier on delivery.

Hope that helps,
Priya

subject: Wrong colour received
body:
Hi,

I ordered the linen apron in olive but received charcoal. The packing slip says olive, so I think the wrong item was picked.

Order #48777. Could you send the olive one and tell me how to return the charcoal?

Thanks,
Theo Brandt

subject: VAT number on invoices
body:
Hello,

Our company VAT number isn't printed on invoices from Harborline, which our accountant needs for reclaiming VAT. Could you add it to future invoices and reissue the last three?

The VAT number is on file under account aisha.bello@example.org.

Thank you,
Aisha Bello

subject: Re: VAT number on invoices
body:
Hi Aisha,

I've added the VAT number to your billing profile and reissued invoices 2288, 2290 and 2294. They're in your billing history now.

Future invoices will include it automatically.

Tom

subject: Bulk pricing for a community event
body:
Hi,

We're organising a community makers' market and would like to buy 120 of the canvas tote bags as welcome kits. Is there bulk pricing at that quantity, and what's the lead time?

The event is on June 14, so we'd need delivery by June 7.

Thanks,
Noah Kim

subject: Re: Bulk pricing for a community event
body:
Hi Noah,

At 120 units you'd qualify for our tier-2 rate of $9.40 per bag, and production takes about 10 business days. If you confirm by May 20 we can comfortably deliver by June 7.

I can send a formal quote if you share the delivery address.

Best,
Priya

body:

Can you unlock it manually?

Thanks,
Hugo Santos

body:

Maya

subject: Does the travel mug fit a car cup holder?
body:
Hi,

Before I order: what's the base diameter of the 16 oz travel mug? My car has narrow cup holders (about 7.5 cm) and I want to check it fits.

Thanks,
Oliver

subject: Re: Does the travel mug fit a car cup holder?
body:
Hi Oliver,

The 16 oz mug has a base diameter of 7.1 cm, so it should sit comfortably in a 7.5 cm holder.

Let us know if you need any other measurements.

Priya

subject: Partnership enquiry: sustainable packaging
body:
Hello,

I represent a small packaging supplier that specialises in recycled and compostable mailers. We work with several homeware brands and would love to explore supplying Harborline.

Could we set up a 20-minute call next week? I'm happy to send samples first.

Best,
Freya Larsen
